services.name: Instant Lead Callback
services.blurb: Calls a web enquiry back within 60 seconds, while they are still on your site.

services.compliance_note: Only calls people who just contacted YOU, about the thing they contacted you about. No cold outbound - an AI voice is an artificial voice under the TCPA, and calling a mobile without prior express written consent carries $500-$1,500 per call.

services.name: Instant Lead Callback

services.name: After-Hours Answering
services.blurb: The phone agent, but only outside your opening hours.

services.compliance_note: Callers are told they are speaking with an automated assistant and that the call is recorded.

services.name: Spanish-Speaking Agent
services.blurb: Your agent handles Spanish callers in Spanish.
services.detail: Detects the caller's language and switches. Added to any voice add-on above.

services.name: Review Requests
services.blurb: Texts a review link after every completed job.

services.name: Missed-Call Text-Back
services.blurb: A call goes unanswered and the caller gets a text from your number within seconds.
services.detail: "Sorry we missed you - what do you need help with?" The reply is captured, qualified, and you are alerted. A plumber missing 6 calls a week who recovers just 2 jobs has already paid for the service.
services.compliance_note: Texts reply only to people who just called you, carry your business name, and honour STOP immediately. Requires A2P 10DLC registration of your number, which we handle.

services.name: Missed-Call Text-Back
services.blurb: A missed call gets an immediate text from your number, and the reply becomes an intake.
services.detail: The caller is asked what happened and when. Nothing is advised, nothing is promised - the reply is captured and flagged for you.
services.compliance_note: No legal advice and no fee quotes are ever sent. Per-lead is per intake delivered, never per case signed. Honours STOP immediately.

services.name: Missed-Call Text-Back

services.name: After-Hours Intake
